# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta12

## Google Satellite sharpness

- Fix Google Satellite briefly appearing sharp and then switching to a visibly blurred lower-resolution view after viewport attribution metadata arrives.
- `maxZoomRects` describes overlapping imagery-availability rectangles. The beta11 card incorrectly treated the lowest `maxZoom` from every overlapping rectangle as one global viewport limit.
- On real field testing this could turn an initially sharp zoom-19 tile set into a much coarser zoom after the Google copyright string appeared.
- Select the highest supported zoom covering the viewport centre instead, falling back to the highest reported overlapping zoom when rectangle coordinates are unavailable.
- Keep the card's existing zoom-19 ceiling, Google attribution, authenticated Home Assistant tile proxy, request concurrency and object-URL cleanup unchanged.
- Record the reported viewport zoom range internally for troubleshooting without exposing credentials or Google session data.

## Compatibility

- No Navimower integration change is required beyond the existing Google Satellite backend introduced in Navimower 0.4.4-beta22.
- OpenStreetMap, Ortofoto and Hübriid rendering are unchanged.
